keyset.caption: How the dispatcher computes a call's key set: the union of the inputs' keys, plus the thread's included keys, minus its excluded keys, minus fallthroughs.

tls_default.caption: The thread-local defaults: ADInplaceOrView is switched on for every call, the Autocast keys are switched off until autocast is entered.

table.caption: How one entry of an operator's dispatch table is chosen (the rule continues below these lines).

fallback.caption: Boxed fallbacks: one function for every operator at the autograd keys; a fallthrough for ADInplaceOrView.

autocast.caption: Autocast on the CPU: a fallthrough for every operator, then a kernel for each operator that should run in lower precision.
autocast.text:
TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL(_, AutocastCPU, m) {
  m.fallback(torch::CppFunction::makeFallthrough());
}


TORCH_LIBRARY_IMPL(aten, AutocastCPU, m) {
  // lower_precision_fp cast policy
  KERNEL_CPU(conv1d, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(conv1d, padding, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(conv2d, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(conv2d, padding, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(conv3d, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(conv3d, padding, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(bmm, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(mm, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(linalg_vecdot, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(baddbmm, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(addmm, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(_addmm_activation, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(addbmm, lower_precision_fp)
  KERNEL_CPU(linear, lower_precision_fp)

inference.caption: What entering inference_mode changes: grad mode off, ADInplaceOrView no longer included, every autograd key excluded.

inplace_view.caption: The ADInplaceOrView kernel of copy_: run the copy below this key, then bump the version counter.

readyqueue.caption: The engine's ready queue: a priority queue on sequence number (later-created nodes first).

accumulate.caption: AccumulateGrad takes the largest sequence number, so it runs as soon as it is ready.

cpuqueue.caption: Which devices share the calling thread's ready queue.

devthreads.caption: One worker thread per non-CPU device, started once.

version.caption: The version check when a saved tensor is unpacked (skipped when saved-tensor hooks are installed).

ckpt_default.caption: checkpoint() without use_reentrant: still a warning and still the reentrant variant at 2.14.1, although the warning names 2.9 for the change.
ckpt_default.text:
if use_reentrant is None:
        warnings.warn(
            "torch.utils.checkpoint: the use_reentrant parameter should be "
            "passed explicitly. Starting in PyTorch 2.9, calling checkpoint "
            "without use_reentrant will raise an exception. use_reentrant=False is "
            "recommended, but if you need to preserve the current default "
            "behavior, you can pass use_reentrant=True. Refer to docs for more "
            "details on the differences between the two variants.",
            stacklevel=3,
        )
        use_reentrant = True

    if kwargs and use_reentrant:

worker_seed.caption: How each DataLoader worker seeds random, torch and numpy.
worker_seed.text:
seed = base_seed + worker_id
        random.seed(seed)
        torch.manual_seed(seed)
        if HAS_NUMPY:
            np_seed = _generate_state(base_seed, worker_id)
            import numpy as np

            np.random.seed(np_seed)
